$comment: Plan S15 Done-when 1, D-061 item 4. Every server action ('use server' export) and route handler: the audited database functions it writes through (supabase/tests/audit_coverage.test.sql), or exempt with the reason. `pnpm audit:check` fails on one missing here.

directWrites.server/check-results.ts#check_results: Probe results (service role): monitoring data, not config or incident state.
directWrites.server/crawler/clean-pages.ts#crawler_cl: Each site's newest clean crawler fetch (service role, D-069): monitoring data for the phrase check, not config or incident state.
directWrites.server/expiry/run-expiry.ts#site_expiry: Certificate and domain expiry reads (service role): monitoring data.
directWrites.server/engine/run-engine.ts#verification: Queues and settles browser-verify jobs (service role); verdicts are judged by audited engine steps.
directWrites.server/verifier/housekeeping.ts#verifica: Removes verify-job rows older than 30 days (retention).
directWrites.server/ingest/bangkok.ts#probe_locations: The Bangkok probe's last heartbeat (service role).
directWrites.server/probe/run-probe.ts#probe_location: A cloud probe location's last heartbeat (service role).
directWrites.server/notifier/dispatch.ts#notification: Delivery state of queued messages (service role): sent, failed, retry time.
The delivery log, one row per attempt (service role, append-only).
directWrites.server/notifier/dispatch.ts#incident_eve: The 'alerted' timeline line after a message went; no incident state changes.
directWrites.features/reports/drafts.ts#client_report: The monthly client report drafts (service role, D-073 items 11, 13): figures worked out from the month's data, not config or incident state.

features/auth/actions.ts#signOut.exempt: Ends the person's own session; changes nothing in the database.

features/settings/actions.ts#loadHandove.exempt: Reads the On-call data the Hand over dialog shows; changes nothing (the hand-over itself is oncall#handOver).

features/maintenance/actions.ts#loadAdmi.exempt: Reads the active Admins' names for the request dialog; writes nothing.

features/maintenance/actions.ts#postWind.exempt: Sends early the messages an audited window action already queued; changes no window or incident.

features/maintenance/actions.ts#postSeri.exempt: Sends early the messages an audited series action already queued; changes no series or window.

features/oncall/actions.ts#setChecklist.exempt: Ticks the person's own phone-readiness checklist (MOnCall); not config or incident state.

features/channels/actions.ts#sendChannel.exempt: Sends the person a Chat or email test; changes no config or incident (S17).

features/oncall/actions.ts#sendTest.exempt: Sends the person a test alert; changes no config or incident.

features/oncall/actions.ts#confirmTest.exempt: Records that the person got their test alert; not config or incident state.

features/organisation/actions.ts#checkPh.exempt: Check phrase: reads where a phrase is found on the stored clean pages; changes nothing.

app/(app)/audit/export/route.ts#GET.exempt: Downloads the audit log as CSV; reads only.

app/(app)/incidents/incidents.csv/route..exempt: Downloads the incident list as CSV; reads only.

app/(app)/sites/[siteId]/checks.csv/rout.exempt: Downloads a site's check log as CSV; reads only.

app/(app)/sites/[siteId]/incidents.csv/r.exempt: Downloads a site's incident history as CSV; reads only.

app/api/cron/housekeeping/route.ts#GET.exempt: Removes screenshots and verify-job rows older than 30 days (retention); no config or incident.

app/api/cron/notifier/route.ts#GET.exempt: Delivers messages that audited actions and engine steps queued.

app/api/cron/expiry/route.ts#GET.exempt: Reads each site's certificate and domain expiry into site_expiry (monitoring data); any incident follows through the audited engine steps.

app/api/cron/reports/route.ts#GET.exempt: Queues and sends the daily digest and the weekly summary; changes no state.

app/api/cron/report-drafts/route.ts#GET.exempt: Stores the last complete month's client report drafts (client_reports and its PDF, service role): a report of the month's figures, not config or incident state.

app/api/reports/[clientId]/[month]/route.exempt: Serves a client's monthly PDF to staff; reads only, writes nothing.

app/api/ingest/route.ts#GET.exempt: Hands the VPS the monitors due from Bangkok and stamps its watchdog beat; no config or incident.

app/api/jobs/route.ts#GET.exempt: Leases browser-verify jobs to the VPS and expires stale ones; the verdicts are judged by audited engine steps.

app/api/expiry/check/route.ts#POST.exempt: Check now on the Expiry page: re-reads certificate and domain dates into site_expiry (monitoring data, no config or incident state).

app/api/monitor-test/sin/route.ts#POST.exempt: Runs one test check from Singapore and stores nothing.

app/api/monitor-test/tyo/route.ts#POST.exempt: Runs one test check from Tokyo and stores nothing.

app/auth/callback/route.ts#GET.exempt: Finishes Google sign-in (sets the session); sign-in auditing is the Access category, S16.

app/auth/refused/route.ts#GET.exempt: Signs out a refused session and shows why; writes nothing.

app/auth/sign-in/route.ts#GET.exempt: Starts Google sign-in (a redirect); writes nothing.
